risks.point: One-time expenses related to the Nagarro acquisition impacting reported EPS growth
risks.verbatim_quote: Overall, we are expecting one-time expenses to the tune of approximately $50 million spread over three to four quarters. These expenses will weigh in on the reported EPS growth as you would have seen in our Q2 results reflecting an impact of around 3.1% on our reported PAT.
